records.trigger_conditions: Foreign-origin article imported into the United States unless a specific exception applies.
records.required_tests: No laboratory test; origin determination and marking review.
records.required_documents: Origin records; entry documents as applicable.
records.seller_importer_actions: Mark the article or, where allowed, its container conspicuously, legibly, indelibly, and permanently with the English country name for the ultimate purchaser.
records.labeling_manual_requirements: Country name on article/container.
records.clarification_question: Where was the article manufactured or substantially transformed, where will origin be marked, and are you claiming a specific marking exception?
records.risk_if_missing: Import delay, marking duties, redelivery, or refusal/penalty exposure.
records.applicability_notes: This is an import rule, not a product-safety test.

records.trigger_conditions: Product is sold into California and the business knowingly and intentionally causes exposure to a listed chemical above the applicable safe-harbor or risk threshold; businesses with fewer than 10 employees are generally exempt.
records.required_tests: Exposure assessment or chemical testing as needed; a chemical's presence alone does not prove a warning is required.
records.required_documents: Supplier declarations, test/exposure assessment, warning decision record.
records.seller_importer_actions: Determine exposure; provide a clear and reasonable warning if required; monitor chemical list and safe-harbor levels.
records.labeling_manual_requirements: Consumer product/online warning format if used; short-form warning rules changed effective 2025 with a three-year transition.
records.clarification_question: Will the product be sold into California, does the business have 10 or more employees, and is there a documented listed-chemical exposure/safe-harbor assessment?
records.risk_if_missing: Private enforcement, civil penalties, listing disruption, or unnecessary-warning risk.
records.applicability_notes: State overlay. Do not auto-trigger a warning from material presence alone.

records.trigger_conditions: Electronic device may be intended primarily for children 12 or younger based on labeling, packaging, advertising, consumer recognition, size, theme, and play value.
records.required_tests: Classification review; CPSC age determination where needed.
records.required_documents: Classification memo and marketing evidence.
records.seller_importer_actions: If child-targeted, route to applicable children's-product and toy rules in addition to FCC/energy/transport rules.
records.labeling_manual_requirements: Age and safety labels as triggered.
records.clarification_question: Is the electronic device intended primarily for children 12 or younger based on age grading, design, packaging, advertising, theme, size, and play value?
records.risk_if_missing: Under-compliance if a child-targeted device is treated as general use.
records.applicability_notes: Ordinary media players/electronics are generally general use, but child-themed or sized versions can be children's products.

records.trigger_conditions: Device intentionally generates and emits RF, including Bluetooth or Wi-Fi, unless a narrow exception applies.
records.required_tests: Applicable Part 15 technical tests by an FCC-recognized accredited laboratory; RF exposure evaluation; TCB review.
records.required_documents: FCC Form 731 application exhibits, test report, operational description, schematics/photos, label, user information, TCB grant/FCC ID.
records.seller_importer_actions: Obtain grant of certification before marketing; ensure production conforms to authorized design; screen Covered List restrictions.
records.labeling_manual_requirements: FCC ID and Part 15 statements/warnings as applicable.
records.clarification_question: Does the device intentionally transmit RF; if yes, what protocols/bands, radio/module/FCC ID, antennas, body separation, simultaneous modes, and Covered List result apply?
records.risk_if_missing: Marketing/import prohibition, enforcement, seizure/recall, Amazon/eBay removal.
records.applicability_notes: Bluetooth certification by the Bluetooth SIG is separate from FCC authorization and is not a substitute.

records.trigger_conditions: Digital device, peripheral, or external switching power supply falls within Part 15 Subpart B and is not exempt.
records.required_tests: Radiated and, where applicable, conducted emissions to the relevant Class A/B limits using recognized measurement procedures.
records.required_documents: SDoC compliance records or certification grant; test report; product compliance information.
records.seller_importer_actions: Select SDoC or certification as allowed by 47 CFR 15.101; maintain records and production conformity.
records.labeling_manual_requirements: Part 15 label and Class A/B user statement as applicable.
records.clarification_question: Is this a digital device/peripheral or switching power supply, what is its highest clock/frequency and power mode, and is it marketed for residential use?
records.risk_if_missing: Marketing/import enforcement and platform removal.
records.applicability_notes: Most consumer devices are Class B; confirm classification rather than assume.

records.trigger_conditions: Potential exemption under 47 CFR 15.103, including a battery-only device whose highest generated/used frequency is below 1.705 MHz and that has no AC operating or charging connection.
records.required_tests: Engineering frequency/power analysis; verify every function is exempt.
records.required_documents: Signed exemption rationale with block diagram, clocks, interfaces, and power modes.
records.seller_importer_actions: Do not claim exemption if device can operate while connected to AC/charger or contains another non-exempt function.
records.labeling_manual_requirements: Even exempt devices remain subject to certain general conditions and good engineering practice.
records.clarification_question: Is the device battery-only, below 1.705 MHz, unable to operate while charging/connected to AC, and free of any other non-exempt RF function?
records.risk_if_missing: False exemption leads to unauthorized marketing/import.
records.applicability_notes: Exemption is narrow and attribute-dependent.

records.requirement: FCC Supplier's Declaration of Conformity responsible party and compliance information
records.trigger_conditions: Equipment uses the SDoC authorization procedure.
records.required_tests: Part 15 Subpart B tests supporting SDoC.
records.required_documents: Compliance information statement and underlying records.
records.seller_importer_actions: Designate a responsible party located in the United States; supply model/product identification, compliance statement, and US contact information at marketing/import.
records.labeling_manual_requirements: Information may be in manual, separate sheet, packaging, or electronic display as permitted.
records.clarification_question: Will the device use the SDoC path, and who is the qualifying U.S.-located responsible party?
records.risk_if_missing: Invalid SDoC, marketing/import enforcement, retailer rejection.
records.applicability_notes: A foreign supplier without a qualifying US responsible party cannot complete this path alone.

records.requirement: FCC product labels and user information
records.trigger_conditions: Part 15 device is authorized; exact content depends on authorization type, size, and device class.
records.required_tests: Artwork/manual review.
records.required_documents: Final label artwork, photos, manual, electronic-label procedure if used.
records.seller_importer_actions: Apply FCC ID to certified equipment; apply Part 15 statement and include modification/interference information as applicable.
records.labeling_manual_requirements: 47 CFR 15.19 device statement; 15.21 modification warning; 15.105 Class A/B interference text; FCC ID under 2.925 for certification.
records.clarification_question: Which FCC authorization path and device class apply, what is the FCC ID if certified, and will labeling be physical or electronic?
records.risk_if_missing: Mislabeling, grant inconsistency, enforcement, platform failure.
records.applicability_notes: Do not place the FCC logo unless the specific authorization/labeling rules permit it.

records.requirement: FCC RF exposure evaluation for portable devices
records.trigger_conditions: Transmitting device is generally used with the radiating structure within 20 cm of the body and exceeds the applicable exemption threshold or has multiple RF sources whose exemption ratio exceeds one.
records.required_tests: SAR or MPE evaluation as prescribed by frequency/use; exemption calculation where eligible.
records.required_documents: RF exposure report/calculation and certification application statement.
records.seller_importer_actions: Evaluate every operating configuration, antenna, power level, and simultaneous transmission mode.
records.labeling_manual_requirements: Exposure separation/use instructions when relied on for compliance.
records.clarification_question: Will any transmitter normally operate within 20 cm of the body, and what are the frequency, power, antenna gain, duty cycle, and simultaneous-transmission configurations?
records.risk_if_missing: Grant denial, unsafe exposure, enforcement or recall.
records.applicability_notes: Earbuds and body-worn devices are normally portable configurations; actual power and distance determine test burden.

records.requirement: FCC RF exposure evaluation for mobile devices
records.trigger_conditions: Transmitting device normally maintains at least 20 cm separation and exceeds the applicable exemption threshold or aggregate ratio.
records.required_tests: MPE/ERP evaluation or applicable measurement.
records.required_documents: RF exposure report/calculation and certification evidence.
records.seller_importer_actions: Document installation/use conditions maintaining separation and assess co-located transmitters.
records.labeling_manual_requirements: Manual/installation separation instructions when relied on.
records.risk_if_missing: Grant denial, enforcement, unsafe exposure.
records.applicability_notes: Portable and mobile definitions are use-configuration based, not merely product names.

records.authority: FCC Office of Engineering and Technology
records.trigger_conditions: Host uses a certified or limited-modular transmitter.
records.required_tests: Review module grant, antennas, RF exposure, co-location, host emissions, and integration instructions; additional testing or permissive change may be required.
records.required_documents: Module FCC grant, OEM integration instructions, host test report, label/manual evidence.
records.seller_importer_actions: Use only authorized configurations; preserve module conditions; label host and complete host digital-device compliance.
records.labeling_manual_requirements: Contains-FCC-ID label and module-required user statements where applicable.
records.clarification_question: Is a certified module used, and do the antenna, power, co-location, host, labeling, and RF-exposure conditions match its grant and integration instructions?
records.risk_if_missing: Unauthorized host configuration, invalid reliance on module grant, platform removal.
records.applicability_notes: Module certification does not automatically authorize the full host product.

records.requirement: DOE external power supply energy conservation
records.trigger_conditions: Included or separately sold unit meets the federal external-power-supply definition and no exception applies.
records.required_tests: 10 CFR part 430 Appendix Z procedure; sampling under 10 CFR 429.37.
records.required_documents: DOE CCMS certification report, test data, basic-model/design-family records.
records.seller_importer_actions: Test and certify before distribution; file annual certification; meet active/no-load standards.
records.labeling_manual_requirements: Permanent Level VI or other required international efficiency mark and nameplate data.
records.clarification_question: Is an external power supply included or sold, and what are its input/output ratings, application, and any claimed exception?
records.risk_if_missing: Distribution prohibition, DOE enforcement, civil penalties, retailer rejection.
records.effective_update_date: Current standards checked 2026-09-09; reporting change effective 2026-05-28
records.applicability_notes: The standard applies to the supply, not automatically to the connected end-use product.

records.trigger_conditions: Product is a covered battery charger manufactured on or after 2018 and no medical-device exclusion applies.
records.required_tests: DOE battery-charger test procedure and sampling; determine rated battery energy and unit energy consumption.
records.required_documents: DOE CCMS certification report, test data, basic-model records.
records.seller_importer_actions: Meet product-class maximum UEC; certify before distribution and annually by September 1.
records.labeling_manual_requirements: Required representations/nameplate information as applicable.
records.clarification_question: Does the product charge a battery, what battery chemistry/energy does it charge, and is any medical-device exclusion claimed?
records.risk_if_missing: Distribution prohibition, DOE enforcement, civil penalties.
records.effective_update_date: Standards apply from 2018-06-13; current eCFR checked 2026-09-09
records.applicability_notes: A USB charging feature can be a covered charger; apply the regulatory definition and exclusions.

records.requirement: Lithium battery UN 38.3 and US transport controls
records.trigger_conditions: Lithium-ion or lithium-metal cell/battery is offered for transportation, whether standalone, packed with, or contained in equipment.
records.required_tests: UN Manual of Tests and Criteria subsection 38.3 for the battery type; packaging/marking analysis under 49 CFR 173.185.
records.required_documents: UN 38.3 test summary; manufacturer test record; battery specification; shipping document where required.
records.seller_importer_actions: Obtain summary before shipping; classify by Wh/lithium content and configuration; package against short circuit, damage, and activation; apply quantity/mode/carrier rules.
records.labeling_manual_requirements: Lithium battery mark and Wh marking where required; exceptions depend on configuration and quantity.
records.clarification_question: Is the battery lithium ion or lithium metal, how is it shipped, what is its Wh/lithium content, how many are in the package, and is a UN 38.3 test summary available?
records.risk_if_missing: Carrier rejection, hazardous-material enforcement, fire risk, platform fulfillment rejection.
records.effective_update_date: Test-summary requirement current; Wh marking change effective 2024-05-10
records.applicability_notes: UN 38.3 is a transport prerequisite, not FCC or product-safety certification.

records.requirement: FCC Covered List authorization prohibition and applicant attestations
records.trigger_conditions: Equipment or producer is on the FCC Covered List, or a certification application/permissive change is filed.
records.required_tests: Supply-chain screening; no test can cure a covered-equipment prohibition.
records.required_documents: Signed Covered List certifications/attestations and supply-chain records.
records.seller_importer_actions: Screen applicant, producer, module, and equipment; submit required statements with certification and changes.
records.labeling_manual_requirements: No consumer label substitutes for the prohibition.
records.risk_if_missing: Certification denial/revocation and marketing/import prohibition.
records.applicability_notes: A 2026 proposal would broaden supply-chain disclosures and add a US liable-party rule; it is not current law.

records.trigger_conditions: Amazon listing is a radio-frequency device or could be interpreted as one, including Wi-Fi/Bluetooth/cellular products and many digital devices.
records.required_tests: No separate platform test; Amazon validates submitted FCC authorization/responsible-party information against listing.
records.required_documents: FCC certification number where required, or US responsible-party contact for SDoC, or permitted declaration that authorization is not required.
records.seller_importer_actions: Complete FCC Radio Frequency Emission Compliance attribute accurately before listing.
records.labeling_manual_requirements: Listing field and supporting documents.
records.clarification_question: Will the product be listed on Amazon US, and which FCC listing value applies: FCC ID, U.S. responsible-party information, or a documented no-authorization basis?
records.risk_if_missing: Listing removal; noncompliant inventory cannot be offered.
records.applicability_notes: The platform field does not determine federal authorization type.

records.requirement: Amazon rechargeable lithium-ion battery compliance verification
records.trigger_conditions: ASIN is a rechargeable lithium-ion/polymer/iron-phosphate battery, replacement pack, rechargeable coin cell, or covered product selected under Amazon's current battery policy.
records.required_tests: Testing/document verification by an Amazon-approved provider; exact document set is product/configuration dependent.
records.required_documents: Provider-requested test reports and transport/safety evidence; listing battery attributes.
records.seller_importer_actions: Complete listing attributes, use approved provider, accept quote, submit samples/documents, and meet Account Health deadlines.
records.labeling_manual_requirements: Battery attributes and safety information.
records.clarification_question: Is the Amazon US ASIN within the rechargeable-lithium policy scope, what battery/configuration is used, and has Account Health requested approved-provider verification?
records.risk_if_missing: ASIN removal or Account Health impact.
records.applicability_notes: Public policy confirms the workflow, but exact help-page document-age wording was not independently retrievable.

records.trigger_conditions: Device lacks required FCC authorization, is recalled/unsafe/prohibited, uses an easily accessible button cell, or matches another listed restriction such as loose 18650 cells.
records.required_tests: Underlying FCC/CPSC/transport tests; listing review.
records.required_documents: FCC authorization evidence, product-safety documents, recall status.
records.seller_importer_actions: Do not list unauthorized or prohibited equipment; preinstall 18650 cells where eBay requires; monitor recalls.
records.labeling_manual_requirements: Accurate safety and authorization information.
records.clarification_question: Will the device be listed on eBay, and does it lack FCC authorization, match a recall/prohibition, use an accessible button cell, or list a loose 18650 cell?
records.risk_if_missing: Listing removal, selling restrictions, account suspension.
records.applicability_notes: EU GPSR disclosure help is not a US requirement and is excluded from this US-only matrix.

records.requirement: Button/coin battery product performance and warnings
records.trigger_conditions: Non-toy consumer product contains or is designed to use a button/coin cell with diameter greater than height; zinc-air cells are excluded.
records.required_tests: ANSI/UL 4200A-2023 battery-compartment accessibility and use-and-abuse tests.
records.required_documents: GCC for non-children's products or CPC for children's products; test report; warning artwork.
records.seller_importer_actions: Secure compartment with a tool or two independent simultaneous actions; meet performance tests; issue certificate.
records.labeling_manual_requirements: Required product, packaging, and manual warnings; battery packaging has separate rules.
records.clarification_question: Does the non-toy product contain or use a button/coin cell whose diameter exceeds its height, is it zinc-air, and is the battery installed or separately packaged?
records.risk_if_missing: Ingestion injury/death, recall, stop sale, platform prohibition.
records.effective_update_date: Product rule effective 2023-10-23; package-label phase effective 2024-09-21
records.applicability_notes: Compliant toy products follow ASTM F963 instead; separately packaged batteries remain separately regulated.

records.requirement: Electrical fire and shock safety standards
records.authority: UL Solutions / applicable NRTL or standard body
records.trigger_conditions: Mains-powered, charging, or energy-containing product presents electrical/fire hazards or a retailer, insurer, procurement contract, code, or product-specific rule requires certification.
records.required_tests: Product-specific safety evaluation, often UL/CSA 62368-1 for audio/video/ICT equipment; battery cell/pack standards may also apply by product and contract.
records.required_documents: NRTL certification/report or engineering safety report when required by the applicable channel.
records.seller_importer_actions: Confirm the exact product standard and whether listing/certification is legally or contractually required; do not represent a universal federal UL mandate.
records.labeling_manual_requirements: Safety marks, ratings, cautions, and manual content under the selected standard.
records.risk_if_missing: Fire/shock injury, recall, insurer/retailer rejection, product-liability exposure.
records.applicability_notes: No blanket federal UL-listing rule was verified for all small consumer electronics.

records.requirement: Proposed FCC 2026 supply-chain and US liable-party changes
records.trigger_conditions: Future certification/import workflows if FCC adopts proposals on HBOM/SBOM, SDoC registration, broader Covered List controls, or a US liable party for foreign grantees.
records.required_tests: Not applicable unless and until finalized.
records.required_documents: Potential future HBOM/SBOM, producer disclosures, and US liable-party records.
records.seller_importer_actions: Monitor ET Docket 21-232; do not enforce in the MVP as current law.
records.labeling_manual_requirements: Potential future database and label controls.
records.risk_if_missing: False positive if treated as law; update risk if ignored after a final rule.
records.applicability_notes: Verification status means the proposal exists; requirement status is proposed, not effective.

records.trigger_conditions: Product is designed, made, or marketed as a plaything for children under 14; CPSC children's-product duties apply when intended primarily for children 12 or younger under the four-factor test.
records.required_tests: Age-determination/classification review.
records.required_documents: Age grading rationale; product, packaging, advertising, and market evidence.
records.seller_importer_actions: Assign age range and classification using all factors; do not rely on a label alone; route child-targeted electronics into CPSC rules.
records.labeling_manual_requirements: Age grading and warnings as required by downstream rules.
records.clarification_question: What age range is intended, and how do the labeling, packaging, advertising, size, theme, play value, and consumer perception support the classification?
records.risk_if_missing: Incorrect routing can omit mandatory tests and certificates or over-apply children's rules.
records.applicability_notes: ASTM F963 scope and CPC/third-party testing scope are not identical.

records.trigger_conditions: Finished product is a toy within 16 CFR part 1250; only provisions applicable to the toy's age, features, materials, and hazards apply.
records.required_tests: Applicable ASTM F963-23 sections, such as mechanical/use-and-abuse, accessible edges/points, small objects, coatings/substrates, and feature-specific tests.
records.required_documents: CPSC-accepted laboratory report for third-party sections; applicability checklist.
records.seller_importer_actions: Identify specific applicable sections; test those sections; cite exact section numbers in reports and CPC.
records.labeling_manual_requirements: ASTM/CPSC warnings, markings, and instructions where the applicable section requires them.
records.clarification_question: What is the intended age, and which materials, coatings, small parts, magnets, batteries, electrical power, and toy feature types are present?
records.risk_if_missing: Stop sale, recall, import detention, platform suppression, and CPC invalidity.
records.effective_update_date: ASTM F963-23 effective 2024-04-20; part 1250 updated in 2026
records.applicability_notes: Section 4.2 flammability and restatements of other CPSC/FDA rules are excluded from the incorporation and handled under their own authority.

records.requirement: CPSC-accepted third-party testing and Children's Product Certificate
records.trigger_conditions: Toy is a children's product subject to one or more children's product safety rules; no valid testing determination removes the test for a component/rule.
records.required_tests: Sufficient samples tested by a CPSC-accepted third-party laboratory for each applicable children's product safety rule.
records.required_documents: CPC in English; underlying test reports; records; seven required CPC data elements.
records.seller_importer_actions: Domestic manufacturer or importer issues and furnishes CPC; maintain and provide reports/certificate; cite each applicable rule and any testing determination or exception.
records.labeling_manual_requirements: Certificate itself; no universal CPC label format.
records.clarification_question: Is this primarily intended for children 12 or younger, and which children's product safety rules apply to the finished product?
records.risk_if_missing: Import refusal, stop sale, recall, civil enforcement, and platform document failure.
records.applicability_notes: Testing relief does not necessarily remove the duty to comply or issue a CPC.

records.requirement: Total lead in accessible component parts
records.trigger_conditions: Accessible component of a children's product; no material determination or statutory exception applies.
records.required_tests: CPSC-recognized lead method appropriate to metal or nonmetal component; component-part testing allowed.
records.required_documents: Lab report or valid component certificate; CPC citation.
records.seller_importer_actions: Ensure accessible components do not exceed 100 ppm; document any determinations and supplier reliance.
records.labeling_manual_requirements: None specific beyond CPC/tracking/other applicable labels.
records.clarification_question: List every accessible component and material, and identify any CPSC material determination or exception being relied on.
records.risk_if_missing: Banned product, recall, import or platform action.
records.applicability_notes: Untreated natural materials and specified unfinished engineered wood may not require third-party testing, but must still comply.

records.requirement: Lead in paint and similar surface coatings
records.trigger_conditions: Toy or children's product bears paint or a similar surface coating; exclusions such as certain printing inks, electroplating, and ceramic glaze must be assessed.
records.required_tests: CPSC lead-in-paint method or accepted alternative for each homogeneous coating as applicable.
records.required_documents: Lab report; CPC citation.
records.seller_importer_actions: Ensure coating lead is below 0.009 percent (90 ppm); define homogeneous coating samples.
records.labeling_manual_requirements: None specific beyond downstream labels.
records.clarification_question: Does any accessible component have paint or a similar surface coating, and what are the coating type and homogeneous colors?
records.risk_if_missing: Banned product, recall, import or platform action.
records.applicability_notes: Do not treat all colorants or inks as surface coatings without classification.

records.requirement: Specified phthalates in accessible plasticized components
records.trigger_conditions: Children's toy for age 12 or younger or child-care article with accessible plasticized components; material determinations may remove third-party testing for specified materials.
records.required_tests: CPSC phthalates method on accessible plasticized component parts.
records.required_documents: Lab report or valid component documentation; CPC citation.
records.seller_importer_actions: Ensure each of DEHP, DBP, BBP, DINP, DIBP, DPENP, DHEXP, and DCHP is at or below 0.1 percent (1,000 ppm).
records.labeling_manual_requirements: None specific beyond CPC.
records.clarification_question: Is the item a toy for age 12 or younger or a child-care article, and which accessible components are plasticized?
records.risk_if_missing: Banned product, recall, import or platform action.
records.applicability_notes: Material determinations concern testing; they are not permission to exceed the limits.

records.requirement: Small-parts ban for children under three
records.trigger_conditions: Toy/article is intended for children under three and contains a small part as received or after applicable use-and-abuse testing, unless an exclusion applies.
records.required_tests: 16 CFR part 1501 small-parts cylinder after applicable 16 CFR 1500 use-and-abuse tests.
records.required_documents: CPSC-accepted lab report; CPC citation.
records.seller_importer_actions: Redesign, age-classify, or remove product if a prohibited small part is present; do not use a warning as a substitute for the ban.
records.labeling_manual_requirements: No warning cures a banned under-three small part.
records.clarification_question: Is the product intended for a child under three, and does any part fit the small-parts cylinder before or after use-and-abuse testing?
records.risk_if_missing: Banned hazardous substance; choking injury, recall, detention, platform removal.
records.applicability_notes: Applicability depends on intended use and specific exclusions.

records.requirement: Choking-hazard warning for certain toys ages three through five
records.trigger_conditions: Specified toy/game for children at least three but under six contains a small part, small ball, marble, or balloon within 16 CFR 1500.19 scope.
records.required_tests: Small-parts/feature assessment; warning-format review.
records.required_documents: Test/assessment record; listing and packaging artwork.
records.seller_importer_actions: Apply required choking warning to packaging and certain catalogs/internet advertisements; keep separate from CPC citations where the warning rule is not a children's product safety rule.
records.labeling_manual_requirements: Specific warning text, size, placement, and advertising disclosure under 16 CFR 1500.19/.20.
records.clarification_question: For a product intended from age three through five, does it contain a small part, small ball, marble, or balloon covered by the warning rule?
records.risk_if_missing: Misbranding, sale restriction, platform suppression, choking risk.
records.applicability_notes: Age range and product form determine the exact warning.

records.requirement: Small balls, marbles, and balloons special rules
records.trigger_conditions: Toy includes a small ball, marble, or latex balloon and falls within an age-specific ban or warning provision.
records.required_tests: Dimensional/product-form tests and age-intent review.
records.required_documents: Lab/assessment record; CPC citation where applicable.
records.seller_importer_actions: Apply the correct ban or warning path; capture the product form explicitly rather than treating it as a generic small part.
records.labeling_manual_requirements: Specific choking warnings where permitted.
records.risk_if_missing: Banned or misbranded product, choking risk, recall.
records.applicability_notes: Special rules can apply even when a generic small-parts flag is insufficient.

records.trigger_conditions: Toy contains magnets; especially small, loose, separable, or liberated magnets after use-and-abuse testing.
records.required_tests: ASTM F963-23 section 4.38 and applicable use-and-abuse, small-part, and flux-index tests.
records.required_documents: CPSC-accepted lab report; CPC citation to ASTM section 4.38.
records.seller_importer_actions: Assess all magnets and containment; the separate 16 CFR part 1262 magnet rule does not apply to toys compliant with part 1250.
records.labeling_manual_requirements: Applicable warnings/instructions under F963.
records.clarification_question: Are magnets present, and can any small magnet become loose or separable after use-and-abuse testing; what is its flux index?
records.risk_if_missing: Ingestion injury or death, recall, import/platform removal.
records.applicability_notes: eBay may prohibit some swallowable child-appealing magnet items even if the federal toy path is documented.

records.trigger_conditions: Toy is battery operated, including toys using button/coin cells.
records.required_tests: ASTM F963-23 section 4.25 battery accessibility and applicable use-and-abuse tests.
records.required_documents: CPSC-accepted lab report; CPC citation to F963 4.25.
records.seller_importer_actions: Secure battery compartments and evaluate small-part batteries; follow tool/access conditions for replaceable batteries.
records.labeling_manual_requirements: Battery-related product, package, and instruction requirements in F963; retain-tool instruction if a custom tool is supplied.
records.clarification_question: Is the toy battery operated, what battery form is used, and how can the battery compartment be opened after use-and-abuse testing?
records.risk_if_missing: Ingestion, burn, fire, recall, stop sale, platform action.
records.applicability_notes: Compliant toy products are exempt from the consumer-product performance rule in part 1263, but separate battery packaging can remain regulated.

records.requirement: Separately packaged button/coin cells included with toy
records.trigger_conditions: Button/coin cell is packaged separately but included with or offered with the toy.
records.required_tests: Package review; special-packaging protocol under Poison Prevention Packaging Act as applicable; no CPSC third-party lab is required solely for special packaging.
records.required_documents: Battery test summary/specification; special-packaging evidence; part 1263 packaging-label evidence; CPC citation where bundled children's-product certification requires it.
records.seller_importer_actions: Use child-resistant, senior-friendly packaging where required; apply battery package warning; obtain supplier evidence.
records.labeling_manual_requirements: 16 CFR 1263.4 battery-package warning; special-packaging information.
records.clarification_question: Is a button/coin cell supplied separately with the toy, and what are its diameter, height, chemistry, and package configuration?
records.risk_if_missing: Battery ingestion risk, stop sale, recall, platform action.
records.effective_update_date: Special packaging effective 2023-02-12; package labeling effective 2024-09-21
records.applicability_notes: Distinguish a cell installed in the toy from a cell supplied in separate packaging.

records.requirement: Electrically operated toys powered from household circuits
records.trigger_conditions: Toy/article intended for children is intended to be powered from nominal 120 V branch circuits; circuits at 30 V rms or less, adult products, and video games are excluded from the definition.
records.required_tests: 16 CFR part 1505 electrical, thermal, mechanical, and construction tests as applicable.
records.required_documents: CPSC-accepted lab report; CPC citation to part 1505.
records.seller_importer_actions: Meet construction/performance limits; provide adequate age-appropriate instructions.
records.labeling_manual_requirements: Electrical ratings, precautionary statements, manufacture date/code, and instructions on toy/package/manual.
records.clarification_question: Is the children's article intended to connect to a nominal 120 V branch circuit, and what are the input and internal circuit ratings?
records.risk_if_missing: Electric shock, burn, fire, banned product, recall.
records.applicability_notes: Battery-low-voltage toys may be outside part 1505 but still subject to ASTM F963 battery requirements.

records.trigger_conditions: All children's products, to the extent practicable.
records.required_tests: No laboratory test; traceability and permanence review.
records.required_documents: Production-lot traceability records.
records.seller_importer_actions: Manufacturer/importer/private labeler places permanent, distinguishing marks on product and packaging where practicable.
records.labeling_manual_requirements: Manufacturer/private labeler, production location/date, and cohort/batch/run information sufficient to trace source.
records.clarification_question: Has the product been confirmed as a children's product (including any child-targeted electronic product)?
records.risk_if_missing: Traceability failure, enforcement exposure, impaired recall, platform concern.
records.applicability_notes: Tracking labels are not themselves a rule to cite on the CPC.

records.trigger_conditions: Change in design, manufacturing process, component source, or factory could affect compliance.
records.required_tests: Retest affected rules/components using a CPSC-accepted lab; full retest may be required for a factory change.
records.required_documents: Updated test reports and new CPC.
records.seller_importer_actions: Assess every change before production; bound the affected requirements; issue a new CPC based on updated evidence.
records.labeling_manual_requirements: Update labels/manuals if change affects them.
records.clarification_question: Since the supporting test, has the design, process, component source, material/color, or factory changed in a way that could affect compliance?
records.risk_if_missing: Stale certificate, noncompliant production, recall/import/platform action.
records.applicability_notes: A purely administrative change may not trigger testing; document the rationale.

records.trigger_conditions: Children's product remains in continuous production after initial certification.
records.required_tests: Periodic testing at intervals set by the manufacturer's testing plan; production testing plan may alter interval within 16 CFR part 1107.
records.required_documents: Periodic testing plan, sample-selection records, reports, CPC updates.
records.seller_importer_actions: Maintain high degree of assurance, select representative samples, retain records.
records.labeling_manual_requirements: Update CPC and product documentation as needed.
records.risk_if_missing: Loss of certification basis and enforcement exposure.
records.applicability_notes: Short production runs under one year can avoid a separate periodic event, but initial and material-change duties remain.

records.trigger_conditions: Water-bead toy or toy containing liquid-absorbent polymer beads.
records.required_tests: Dehydrated/expanded size passage test, 72-hour expansion protocol, extractable acrylamide analysis, and applicable F963 tests.
records.required_documents: CPSC-accepted lab report; CPC citing 16 CFR 1250.4 and applicable F963 sections.
records.seller_importer_actions: Meet size and 325 microgram extractable-acrylamide limits; apply product/package/manual warnings.
records.labeling_manual_requirements: Permanent English warnings on product/container/package and matching instructional warnings.
records.risk_if_missing: Ingestion/aspiration injury, banned product, recall, platform removal.
records.applicability_notes: eBay separately prohibits water beads in Toys & Hobbies or when advertised for children.

records.trigger_conditions: Article encircles and supports a child by the neck, is for water play, and is intended for children through age four.
records.required_tests: Thermal/saltwater/UV conditioning, buoyancy, restraint release, neck-opening head-probe tests, and applicable F963 tests.
records.required_documents: CPSC-accepted lab report; CPC citing 16 CFR 1250.5 and applicable F963 sections.
records.seller_importer_actions: Meet construction/performance rules; supply fit, maintenance, use, and leak-check instructions as applicable.
records.labeling_manual_requirements: Permanent English drowning warnings on product/package; separate manual with same warnings and use instructions.
records.risk_if_missing: Drowning risk, banned product, recall, import/platform action.
records.applicability_notes: Specialty rule with high test cost; exclude from first demo unless product attribute is true.

records.trigger_conditions: Children's toy ASIN offered in the US Amazon store and selected/notified under the policy.
records.required_tests: Annual product testing or document verification by an Amazon-approved testing, inspection, and certification provider.
records.required_documents: Provider-verified test evidence and compliance documents requested for the ASIN.
records.seller_importer_actions: Use the Compliance Reference workflow, select an approved provider, accept quote, submit samples or documents, and resolve Account Health due dates.
records.labeling_manual_requirements: Listing images/labels and documents as provider requests.
records.clarification_question: Is this children's toy ASIN offered in Amazon US, has Amazon requested Direct Validation, and is there a CPSC-accepted report issued within the past 12 months?
records.risk_if_missing: ASIN removal or account-health impact.
records.applicability_notes: Provider price is quote-based and was not publicly verified.

records.trigger_conditions: Toy/product is recalled, prohibited, presents identified product-safety hazards, or matches an eBay-specific prohibition such as certain swallowable child-appealing magnets or child-marketed water beads.
records.required_tests: No fixed platform lab method; underlying regulatory tests and listing review.
records.required_documents: Applicable certificates/reports; recall status; listing content.
records.seller_importer_actions: Do not list prohibited products; monitor recalls and category-specific examples; remove unsafe inventory.
records.labeling_manual_requirements: Accurate safety information and warnings where allowed.
records.clarification_question: Will the toy be listed on eBay, and is it recalled or within an eBay-specific prohibition such as certain swallowable magnets, button-battery products, or child-marketed water beads?
records.risk_if_missing: Listing removal, selling restrictions, or account suspension.
records.applicability_notes: Platform prohibition may be stricter than federal eligibility.
